'''Land's End''' is a small village in [[Great Kourend]] that is located in the south-western corner of the kingdom, within its [[Kourend Woodland|Woodland]].

Taking a boat here is a task in the [[easy Kourend & Kebos Diary]].

==Transportation==
Players can reach Land's End via [[Port Sarim]] or [[Port Piscarilius]] by speaking to [[Veos]] (or [[Cabin Boy Herbert]] after [[A Kingdom Divided]]), and can leave the village via the small port where [[Captain Magoro]] is. Using [[Rada's blessing]]'s teleport to [[Kourend Woodland]] is also a fast way to get there. It can also be reached via [[charter ship]]. 

With a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]] installed on a [[Boat|player-owned boat]] docked there, [[Teleport to Boat]] can also be used.

==Features==

=== Bank chest ===
A [[bank chest]] can be found within [[Hugor]]'s house, and a [[deposit box]] can be found just outside his house as well. In addition, there is a water pump just outside [[Lan the Butcher]]'s house.

=== Skilling ===
There are also [[fishing spots]] for small net, big net, cage, and harpoon fishing to catch most common fish up to [[shark]]s, as well as two [[redberry]] bushes and five [[flax]] plants.

=== Spawns ===
Lastly, a [[lit candle]], [[crossbow]], and a pile of [[bones]] spawn in the village. Players can also find various hunting equipment in crates throughout the village:
*[[Bird snare]] - the south-western crate in Hugor's house
*[[Box trap]] - the crate adjacent to the bookcases in the north-western house
*[[Insect net]] - the crate in the north-east corner of Lan the Butcher's house

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Land's End with level 5 [[Sailing]], provided they have also visited [[Kourend]] at least once. 

The dock south of the town offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

==Charter ship==
The [[charter ship]]s also have a dock in the harbour in Land's End. It provides rides to several other locations. After completing [[Cabin Fever]], the charter ship fare is reduced by 50%. Wearing the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also reduces the fare by 50%. These two bonuses can be stacked to reduce the cost to 25%.
